company: Fountainhead Hotels (hotel group of Fountainhead Development, Inc.)
THE_RULE: This file is the ONLY source of truth downstream. Nothing may be cited that is not here. The fact-checker explicitly did NOT re-verify, and therefore FORBIDS citing: the museum relocation and its dates, the meetings and weddings venues and their square footages, the RFP forms, Zoe Hill, Sandyb@, the iHotelier/TravelClick booking path, Zach's restaurant hours, the wildlife sanctuary figures, the Chamber's 'over 700 rooms' line, the Bridgewater question, and every competitor fact other than the Fairbanks Hampton Inn and the Fairbanks SpringHill Suites. Also forbidden: any revenue figure (none exists), any current headcount, and the Canary 40 percent number except in the attributed form of c46.
DRIFT_WARNING: The fact-checker found that every substantive rejection leaned the same way, toward making Fountainhead look more strained, more sharply seasonal and further behind than its own pages support. Bear Lodge's season was tightened by borrowing the restaurant's dates. An eight-year-old headcount sat beside 2026 facts. One anonymous review supplied the only turnover claim. A vendor number inflated the unanswered-call problem. On the competitor side, a members-only US beta was rendered as live across 10,000 properties and an amenity-list entry became a described 1am desk bypass. Individually small, together they build a company more desperate and more outgunned than the evidence shows. Do not rebuild that shape. The company's own voice is the strongest material here and it needs no amplification.

verified_claims.claim: The Golden Bear Restaurant at Bear Lodge is open during summer months, mid-May to mid-September.
verified_claims.verbatim: Open during summer months (mid-May to mid-September), the Golden Bear Restaurant

verified_claims.verbatim: this excludes tour groups and large groups traveling together.

verified_claims.claim: Alaska Business Magazine's November 2018 profile said Fountainhead Development had more than 600 rooms across three Fairbanks properties.
verified_claims.verbatim: Fountainhead Development Inc., (FDI) has more than 600 rooms spread across three distinctive Fairbanks properties

verified_claims.verbatim: Established in 1985, Fountainhead Development Inc. (FDI) is an integral part of the fabric that makes up Fairbanks, Alaska.
verified_claims.note: Employer self-description, not independent. The 1985 founding is safe.

verified_claims.claim: Tim Cerny is president of Fountainhead Development and spoke to Alaska's News Source in April 2026 about the museum relocation.
verified_claims.verbatim: We've decided to stick with the Fountainhead Antique Auto Museum logo and name because we spent 20 years getting recognized nationally and internationally for what we do in Fairbanks, Alaska.
verified_claims.note: Page renders his title as 'Tim Cerny, the president of Fountainhead Development'. Use the FULL quote, never the truncated capital-W version.

verified_claims.claim: A Texas A&M study of 340 UK adults who had used chatbots to book hotels, published in the International Journal of Hospitality Management, found chatbot inaccuracy produced an effect more than four times larger than incredibility.
verified_claims.verbatim: path coefficient more than four times larger than incredibility
verified_claims.note: Attribute the researcher as Babak Taheri, Texas A&M College of Agriculture and Life Sciences. NOT Naeem Akhtar, that attribution was rejected.

verified_claims.claim: In the same study, discomfort reduced users' willingness to continue interacting with the chatbot by nearly 38%.
verified_claims.verbatim: reduced users' willingness to continue interacting with the chatbot by nearly 38%

verified_claims.claim: In the same study, chatbot inaccuracy nearly doubled the likelihood a user would delay or abandon a booking decision.
verified_claims.verbatim: nearly doubled the likelihood they would delay or abandon a booking decision
verified_claims.note: The article attaches this specifically to inaccuracies about ROOM RATES AND CANCELLATION POLICIES. Do not generalize beyond that framing.

verified_claims.claim: In the Mews Hotelier Survey 2026, 59% of hoteliers say the front desk welcome and check-in should stay human-led.
verified_claims.verbatim: 59% of hoteliers say the front desk welcome and check-in should stay human-led.
verified_claims.note: VENDOR-RUN SURVEY. Mews is a PMS vendor surveying its own base. Must be attributed to Mews by name.

verified_claims.claim: The same Mews survey covered more than 500 properties globally between December 2025 and March 2026, and found 98% of hoteliers had used AI across their operations in the last six months.
verified_claims.verbatim: The Mews Hotelier Survey 2026, conducted between December 2025 and March 2026 across more than 500 properties globally
verified_claims.note: Vendor-run, attribute. The 98% is a customer-base figure and overstates the wider market, say so if used.

verified_claims.claim: AHLA's Front Desk Feedback survey of 282 hoteliers, run with Hireology between December 6 2024 and January 3 2025, found 65% of surveyed hotels report staffing shortages.
verified_claims.verbatim: nearly two-thirds (65%) of surveyed hotels continue to report shortages

verified_claims.claim: In the same AHLA survey, housekeeping at 38% and front desk at 26% were the most acute departmental shortages.
verified_claims.note: Both figures confirmed present but returned summarized rather than as one contiguous sentence. Use as numbers with attribution, do NOT wrap in quotation marks as a quoted sentence.

verified_claims.claim: In the same AHLA survey, 71% of hotels had job openings they were unable to fill despite active searches, averaging six to seven open positions per property.
verified_claims.verbatim: On average, hotels are trying to fill six to seven open positions per property.

verified_claims.claim: An independent eight-week test of Optii housekeeping AI at an 80-room Amsterdam hotel in January to February 2026 measured an average 2.5 minutes saved per room clean.
verified_claims.verbatim: AI route optimisation saved an average of 2.5 minutes per room clean across our eight-week test
verified_claims.note: The single strongest independent measurement in the package. Keep property size and occupancy attached, the figure does not travel without them.

verified_claims.claim: That test valued the saving at approximately EUR 13,800 per year at 80 rooms and 73% occupancy against a fully loaded staff cost of EUR 16 per hour.
verified_claims.verbatim: approximately 13,800 EUR per year at 80 rooms and 73% occupancy, against fully-loaded staff cost of 16 EUR/hour
verified_claims.note: Property-specific. Do not rescale without stating it as a modeled assumption.

verified_claims.claim: The same independent reviewer called Optii's marketed 500% ROI fiction for a well-run 80-room hotel while confirming the labour savings are real.
verified_claims.verbatim: To get to 500% ROI, you'd need labour savings of five times your subscription cost
verified_claims.note: RENDERER TRAP. The reviewer's next sentence opens with 'But', which the VOICE law bans. Paraphrase outside quotation marks rather than editing the source.

verified_claims.claim: The same reviewer summarized the result as the AI working with real but smaller-than-marketed labour savings.
verified_claims.verbatim: The AI does work, the labour savings are real (though not 18% in my case)

verified_claims.claim: Amadeus announced Email to RFP inside MeetingBroker on June 17 2025, powered by Azure OpenAI, generating property-specific responses to inbound RFP emails.
verified_claims.verbatim: Email to RFP, a new AI enhancement within MeetingBroker will enable hotels to automatically generate contextual, property-specific responses to inbound request for proposal (RFP) emails.
verified_claims.note: VENDOR PRESS RELEASE.

verified_claims.claim: Amadeus names Omni Atlanta Hotel as the first pilot customer, reporting only faster responses and near autonomous RFP handling with no numbers.
verified_claims.verbatim: Omni Atlanta Hotel, the first pilot customer, has seen significant returns with faster responses and near autonomous RFP handling.
verified_claims.note: VENDOR CLAIM, no baseline, no measurement period. If used, the absence of numbers must be stated, which is the more persuasive framing anyway.

verified_claims.claim: The Fairbanks Hampton Inn & Suites property page at 433 Harold Bentley Avenue lists Digital Key as a Hilton Honors amenity, and the property has 101 guest rooms.
verified_claims.verbatim: Digital Key
verified_claims.note: Confirmed in the Conveniences amenity list. This is an amenity LISTING only. The page does NOT describe a check-in flow or say a guest can bypass the front desk, that inference was rejected.

verified_claims.claim: The Fairbanks SpringHill Suites by Marriott property page at 575 1st Avenue lists Mobile Key among on-site property amenities.
verified_claims.verbatim: Mobile Key
verified_claims.note: Amenity listing only. 'Guests unlock rooms via the Bonvoy app' is an inference, not page text.

verified_claims.claim: Hilton announced the Hilton AI Planner, a generative AI-powered digital concierge, on March 10 2026, initially in beta to a small pool of hilton.com traffic, with all hilton.com visitors given access as of March 17 2026.
verified_claims.note: RENDERER TRAP. The on-page description contains an EN DASH in 'AI-powered'. Paraphrase outside quotation marks, never silently swap the character inside a quotation.

verified_claims.claim: Marriott introduced Ask Bonvoy, a conversational natural language search experience, in beta on June 16 2026.
verified_claims.verbatim: a new conversational, natural language search experience
verified_claims.note: SCOPE LIMIT, ENFORCED. Beta is US English only, on Marriott.com and the iOS/Android apps, TO A SUBSET OF MEMBERS, with full global release planned later in 2026. The ~10,000 properties figure describes the SEARCHABLE PORTFOLIO, not the beta footprint. Never write 'in beta across roughly 10,000 properties'.

verified_claims.claim: Canary Technologies' widely quoted figure that 40% of calls to hotel front desks go unanswered is stated by Aman Shahi, Canary's VP of Product, with no cited study or methodology, in an article naming no property and reporting no post-deployment measurement.
verified_claims.verbatim: We found that actually 40% of calls to front desks go unanswered
verified_claims.note: VENDOR-SOURCED. MUST be attributed in this form or not used. The verified claim is that a Canary executive SAID it, not that it is true. It may NOT be used to size a Fountainhead call-volume problem and may NOT appear anywhere in the ROI model.

verified_claims.claim: MIT Project NANDA, State of AI in Business 2025, reports roughly 95 percent of enterprise generative-AI pilots produce no measurable P&L impact.
verified_claims.note: Industry base rate, never a fact about this company. Sourced in knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md as authoritative tier. Directional, denominator debated.

verified_claims.claim: RAND, The Root Causes of Failure for AI Projects, finds more than 80 percent of AI projects fail, about twice the rate of non-AI IT projects.
verified_claims.note: Industry base rate, never a fact about this company. Sourced in knowledge/AI_SCOPING.md as authoritative tier.

rejected_do_not_use: Bear Lodge operating 'mid-May to mid-September' as its room season. Those dates belong to the Golden Bear Restaurant. The lodge says only that it is 'a seasonal hotel'.
The anonymous Indeed review about turnover. One anonymous review is not evidence about a company and is a reputational hazard in a document sent to that company.
'Group transportation must be arranged through tour providers.' Not confirmed on the page.
'excludes tour and large groups' as a quoted string. The page says 'this excludes tour groups and large groups traveling together.'
Naeem Akhtar as lead author of the chatbot study. The page names Babak Taheri.
'600+ rooms across three properties' as a quotation. The source wrote 'more than 600 rooms spread across three distinctive Fairbanks properties'.
The truncated standalone Cerny quote beginning 'We spent 20 years'. It is a dependent clause in the source.
The Canary 40 percent as an industry fact or as a sizing input.
'Ask Bonvoy in beta across roughly 10,000 properties'. Overstates the rollout.
Any claim that a guest can skip the desk at the Hampton or the SpringHill. Amenity listings only, no check-in flow described.
